W3F DV Cohort IV Report

Vote Counts
Displays the total number of votes by delegates after the selected filters are applied. This includes referenda that were either active at the time of delegation or submitted after the delegation date. For referenda with multiple votes by the same delegate, only the most recent vote is counted. Voting data is updated every 5 minutes.
Feedback Rate
Displays the percentage of votes where delegates provided rationale or feedback for their decision. Higher feedback rates indicate better delegate engagement and transparency. Retracted and erroneous proposals are excluded from this evaluation. Feedback posts are imported at 30-minute intervals.
Policy Direction
The number of nay votes subtracted from the number of aye votes. A more positive value may indicate support for a more libertarian policy, while more negative values may reflect a more conservative policy.
Similarity Matrix
While the colour of the circle represents agreement or disagreement between two delegates, the size of the circle reflects the magnitude of that (dis)agreement. A large green circle indicates strong agreement, whereas a large red circle indicates strong disagreement. Smaller circles represent more neutral relationships. Abstain votes and no-shows are ignored.
Average First Vote Time After Submission
Displays the average time elapsed from the on-chain submission of referenda to the first on-chain vote by delegates.
Not Voted
The number of referenda that have not yet been voted on by delegates. For closed referenda, this represents the number of missed votes.
Vote Changes
Displays the number of times each delegate has changed their vote between aye, nay, and abstain.
Votes
List of vote calls for all filtered referenda. Only the final call on each referendum is displayed. For multisig calls, only the call that triggered execution is included. 💬 indicates that the delegate left feedback for their rationale, and ⚠️ indicates missing feedback. Retracted or erroneuous proposals are indicated with strikethrough.
